name: Valda Yngling-Åström
text_appearance: Valda is a stern-faced, middle-aged woman with tan skin. She's of average height, but is broad-shouldered and clearly muscular. The wrinkles and scars across her face and body suggest a lifetime spent enduring some of the harshest environments known to Union. She's dressed practically, wearing a weathered brown bomber-style jacket with a white fur ruff, and black jeans - the only ornamentation being silver Sparri style earrings, shaped like circuit boards. Her eyes are narrow and focused, but there is a glint of warmth in them.
history: Valda was born on Sparr as part of clan Yngling, nomads who travel the icy wastes. She's been on her roadcarving for 30 years now, traveling to some of the furthest reaches of Union as part of a Far-Field team. (Finish the rest of this later. Incorporate some family backstory, and rumors about her travels. Including potentially a near death experience on some frozen wastes)

systems.flavorDescription: Derived from a rather benign HORUS script, mimic meshes extend across projected sensor ranges to feed live positional and superpositional data to the pilot. This multidimensional data equips an effective leader to coordinate their allies’ movement with the assurance of survival.

The //SCORPION program has a long history on the omninet despite its rather mundane operation (for HORUS-tagged code, at least). Traced back to pre-Deimos theorycode found on an obscure research paper discussing pre-NHP machine mind reflex-responses, //SCORPION evolved from a simple packet interpreter to a robust anti-incursion program, nimble enough to adapt to most any market-line system that receives its broadcast.
By installing additional armor plating, redundant firing circuits, and enhanced insulation to magazines the longevity of a frame’s armaments can be greatly enhanced.

bondPowers.name: Pounce
bondPowers.description: You take an action before any NPCs have the chance to act, giving you a free roll. Hostile NPCs can’t deal harm or consequences to you as a part of this roll (they’re too slow), although you can still fail or suffer other consequences normally.

bondPowers.name: Don’t Tell Me the Odds
bondPowers.description: Gain +1 Accuracy on all actions in a scene where you are clearly outnumbered, outgunned, or backed into a corner.

bondPowers.name: Momentum
bondPowers.description:
When you survey a situation, ask one of the following questions and get a truthful answer from the GM:
  • How do I think I can get around this obstacle ?
  • What’ s the most direct way forward ?
  • Which way do I feel I should be moving ?
You or an ally of your choice gets + 1 Accuracy on their next skill check acting on the answer.

bondAnswers: A long time spent alone in the cold, a time you’d rather forget.
The wounds and scars that deform you.
minorIdeal: I showed someone how it’s done.

armor.flavorDescription: These hardsuits, common among military units, feature heavier plating than light hardsuits but more mobility than heavy hardsuits. They are powered, augmenting the user’s strength, and typically feature an onboard computer, sensor suite, integrated air, burst EVA system, and waste recycling systems.

weapons.flavorDescription: Heavy signature weapons are missile tubes, heavy lasers, light machine gun, or exotic rifles.

These weapons were made using pre-Union alloys and technology, and might be anything from industrial-era steel swords through to stone axes. While they remain widely used on some worlds, archaic weapons used by pilots are usually relics, heirlooms, or ceremonial weapons.

gear.flavorDescription: This kit contains many essentials for surviving in hostile environments: a rebreather, water filters, hardsuit patches, backup thermals, a bivouac kit, and so on.

This reinforced winter coat is made out of the fur of a Glacier Beast, and can be worn over most other clothing and armor. When wearing this coat in snowy conditions, characters have +1 Accuracy when they Act Unseen or Unheard, and can become Invisible whilst stationary.
This clear, plastic-like sheet can be placed over the wounds of severely injured pilots. It instantly begins to stabilize them, injecting medicine and deploying nanites to stitch wounds shut.
